hints.title: Ordered Combination Sequence Precomputation
hints.text: Combinations of fixed length in sorted lexicographical order can be enumerated using recursive backtracking.

hints.title: State Pointer over Generated Pool
hints.text: Precompute all combinations upon initialization and advance an index pointer on next calls.

hints.title: Bitmask or Index Combination Blueprint
hints.text: Iterate through descending binary masks of weight k or advance pointer array [idx_1, idx_2, ..., idx_k] from right to left.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Generating all C(N, K) combinations upfront allows instantaneous O(1) subsequent iterations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-searching for next lexicographical combination without state requires repeated full permutations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pre-materializing combinations trades memory for O(1) next and hasNext execution.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precomputation via backtracking or online index array mutation.
